paragraphs.text: Sosuke (SOH-soo-kay or SOH-soo-keh ) was an orochi warrior on Kamigawa . Son of Seshiro , grandson of Suzue , and brother of Sachi , he became leader of the Kashi Tribe.
Sosuke was the strongest son of Seshiro. He became chief of the Kashi Tribe and was a leader of the Orochi with his sister when they were attacked by the Moonfolk of Oboro .
